title: Backstop MCP Values
description: Values for the Backstop MCP Helm chart. Python FastMCP server with OAuth credential bridging to Backstop CRM. Exposure uses base chart Gateway API routes (no custom Ingress).

mcpConfig.description: Per-client, non-secret settings mapped to environment variables on the app container. A field is rendered only when set, so an unset field keeps the app default. Takes precedence over the same variable under env, which reaches the container through a ConfigMap. Secrets stay in envVars.

enabled.description: If disabled, none of the fields below are mapped to environment variables.

publicBaseUrl.description: PUBLIC_BASE_URL. The URL clients and browsers reach this server on, which is also the OAuth issuer. Required in production. Must match routes.hostname, e.g. https://backstop-mcp.<tenant>.unique.app.

baseUrl.description: BACKSTOP_BASE_URL. Backstop REST API origin: the tenant host (https://<firm>.backstopsolutions.com) or the shared API host. Unset means https://api.backstopsolutions.com.

uiBaseUrl.description: BACKSTOP_UI_BASE_URL. CRM UI origin used to build links to records. Unset means no links, unless baseUrl is already the tenant host.

employment.description: Departed-contact detection: which entity-relationship types mean employment, and which mean it has ended. Each list is rendered comma-separated. null keeps the app default. A markers list, even an empty one, replaces the app default. The two marker lists must not overlap.

relationshipTypeIds.description: BACKSTOP_EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_IDS. Relationship type ids that mean employment, as strings. Exact match. App default: none.

relationshipTypeMarkers.description: BACKSTOP_EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_MARKERS. Case-insensitive substrings of a type's name that mean employment. App default: [employ].

formerRelationshipTypeIds.description: BACKSTOP_FORMER_EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_IDS. Relationship type ids that mean employment has ended, as strings. Include the mirror type's id too. App default: none.

formerRelationshipTypeMarkers.description: BACKSTOP_FORMER_EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_MARKERS. Case-insensitive substrings that mean employment has ended. App default: [former, previous, ex-, no longer].

tenantGuidance.description: BACKSTOP_MCP_TENANT_GUIDANCE, rendered as JSON. Text appended to the server instructions and to individual tool and parameter descriptions. Empty means the shipped descriptions only. Set per deployment; the chart ships tenant-neutral.

server_instructions.description: Free text appended to the server instructions.

tools.description: Per-tool text, keyed by tool name.

description.description: Free text appended to this tool's description.

parameters.description: Free text appended to a top-level input property, keyed by property name.

tenantGuidance.description: Removed: set mcpConfig.tenantGuidance instead. Rejected so that guidance left here fails the install rather than being dropped.
